findings.title: Choice-format branches bypass HTML validation entirely
findings.body: Replacing the entire choice expression with "..." removes its rendered text from security validation, not just the choice operator. For example, an error-invalid-multivalued-size translation containing `{2,choice,0#<script>alert(1)</script>|1#value}` passes this verifier because the script is discarded before sanitization, although MessageFormat can emit it at runtime. Validate the contents of each choice branch rather than excluding the whole expression. The same bypass affects linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit keys.

findings.title: Overlapping prefix and suffix cause diagnostic generation to throw
findings.body:
The suffix comparison is not bounded by the prefix already consumed. If a message is `a
`, sanitization produces `a`, and both start and end become 1. The subsequent `sanitized.substring(1, 0)` throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of reporting illegal HTML. Bound the suffix scan so it cannot overlap the matched prefix in either string; otherwise ordinary invalid translations abort verification without the intended diagnostic.

findings.title: Preserve the React consoles' interpolation syntax
findings.body: This resource uses i18next interpolation (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}`), but the replacement uses Java MessageFormat placeholders and a Java choice expression. i18next will not substitute these single-braced parameters or evaluate the choice expression, so multivalued-size validation errors display literal formatting syntax instead of the attribute and limits. The same change in the admin-ui English resource has the same problem. Keep console-compatible formatting rather than copying the server-side MessageFormat string.

findings.title: The Lithuanian OTP instruction was replaced with Italian
findings.body: The new totpStep1 value, `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, is Italian, not Lithuanian. This replaces a Lithuanian instruction and makes OTP setup instructions appear in the wrong language for Lithuanian users. The identical replacement in the Lithuanian login bundle's loginTotpStep1 also needs a Lithuanian translation.
